ValidationRule.description: Refer for refer out is mandatory when user clicked on Referred Out To PRO
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: if ( AND (ISCHANGED (StageName),OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Referred Out To PRO")) ), if ( OR (ISBLANK(Referred_out_Details__c),ISBLANK(Patient_Name__c),ISBLANK(TEXT(Reason_for_deniel__c))), true,false ),false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please Enter Referred Out to PRO Details & Reason for Close Refer Out
